This tactical change included a strategic overload in directness, with directness rising from 0.66 to 0.81, facilitating quicker vertical transitions to exploit spaces behind Redmond Rovers' high defensive line while maintaining stable possession and pass accuracy [#1477]. The result was a substantial increase in field tilt from 5.9% to 65.2%, accompanied by a rise in expected goals from 0 to 0.6, shots from 0 to 5, and box touches from 1 to 8, reflecting enhanced presence in the attacking third and more progressive passes into dangerous areas [#1477]. Despite this intensified press and direct approach disrupting Redmond’s rhythm, Redmond Rovers maintained their lead at 3-2 [#1477].
